name: knowledge_search
title: Search the knowledge base
description: Full-text search over the owner's knowledge documents (Russian and English). Returns the matching sections as JSON: id, title, heading, score, snippet, path, type, description, status, stale. Documents with status deprecated come last. Read a whole section with knowledge_get.

query.description: words to look for; all of them must appear

type.description: only documents of this type (case-insensitive, for example Runbook)

name: knowledge_get
title: Read one knowledge document
description: The markdown of one document by id, or of a single "## " section when heading is given.

heading.description: a "## " heading inside that document; omit for the whole document

name: knowledge_list
title: List the knowledge documents
description: Every document as JSON: id, title, type, description, tags, status, stale, updated, path, headings. Documents with status deprecated come last.

type.description: only this type (case-insensitive, for example Runbook)

name: knowledge_usage
title: Which knowledge documents are read
description: What the knowledge documents are used for, as JSON rows, the most read first: id, type, status, gets (times the document or one of its sections was read), hits (times a search returned it), days (distinct UTC dates with a get inside the window), last (UTC date of the newest get, null when never read). Unread documents are listed with zeros. With candidates, only the documents read often enough on enough days to be worth turning into a skill. Looking at the numbers is not a read.

since.description: the window, a whole number of days and a d, for example 30d (default 30d)

type.description: only documents of this type (case-insensitive, for example Runbook)

all.description: also list the ids that have events but are no longer in the folder

candidates.description: only the documents that are not deprecated and were read at least min_gets times on at least min_days dates

min_gets.description: gets a candidate needs inside the window (default 5)

min_days.description: UTC dates a candidate needs a get on inside the window (default 3)

name: sessions_recent
title: Recent Claude sessions on this machine
description: The latest sessions across every Claude account on this machine, newest first — the same text the sessions CLI prints.

name: sessions_search
title: Find a Claude session
description: Sessions whose project path or opening prompt contains every one of these words — the same text the sessions CLI prints.
